222-527-4460-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4460-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2724-7334-8172.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos or Wormfang Manta.
2724-7334-8172.description:
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, attacking a player who cannot kill it in combat.
When The Neutrinos attacks, it triggers, exiling and returning (tapped and attacking) Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

147-2034-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2034-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

728-3108-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
728-3108-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

2393-2738-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sifter of Skulls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

620-2111-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1263-3220-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2506-6441-7150-7752.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.

Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2854-3200-4574-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-3200-4574-6650.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1940-4487-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Phyrexian Marauder from your library.
Repeat.

Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Twitch by paying {2}{U}, targeting Echo Mage.
Holding priority, activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Twitch twice, with the copies targeting an Island and Echo Mage.
Resolve both Twitch copies, untapping Echo Mage and an Island and causing you to draw two cards.

When the Clue enters the battlefield, Sarinth Steelseeker and Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Sarinth Steelseeker trigger, putting Moss-Pit Skeleton from the top of your library into your graveyard.
Resolve the Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

695-813-2104.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Settle Beyond Reality.
695-813-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

When the persist creature dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

When Danitha dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

Activate Spy Kit's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Promising Stairs.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Promising Stairs triggers, causing you to surveil 1 and win the game.

"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
373-877-4484-5231.description:

Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {R}.

When the Goblin dies, Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token.
Repeat.

411-2104-3198.description:
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, putting it under Grinning Ignus.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it and Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Pemmin's Aura attached to Vorel.
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
4 charge counters on Gemstone Array.

Pay {U}{G} and tap Vorel, doubling the number of charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Remove 3 charge counters from Gemstone Array to add {U}{U}{G}.
Pay {U} to untap Vorel.
Repeat.

739-2935-3350.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers.
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life, preventing the next one damage that will be dealt to Ethereal Champion this turn.
Repeat step 2 until you have zero life.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
